icons.name: language
icons.heading: Language
icons.description: The language switches. Light: the A slides out to the left as a 文 slides in from the right and holds for a moment, then the 文 slides on out and the A comes back in from the right and settles, like flipping through a list of languages. Strong: the A pulls back before it leaves, each glyph lands with an overshoot, the 文 holds longer, and the bubble puffs about its tail as each one arrives. The glyphs cross-fade, so the bubble is never empty.

icons.name: region
icons.heading: Region
icons.description: The world turns to your region and the pin marks it. Light: the globe turns one step (its meridian narrows to a line and opens out again) while the pin lifts off it, and as the globe stops the pin plants back on it with a hit; the globe dips under the impact and the pin settles. Strong: the globe spins two steps, the pin lifts higher, lands with a hit and bounces once, and the globe dips harder.

Light: the wrench winds back a little, cranks hard clockwise about the nut held in its jaw and stops dead, three short marks flash out of the jaw as it bites, and the wrench swings back and settles. Strong: it ratchets twice, crank, swing back, a harder crank, with a flash of marks on each bite. The wrench stays rigid and turns about the nut.

icons.name: trackpad
icons.heading: Trackpad
icons.description: A two-finger swipe. Light: the two fingertips swipe right across the pad, tracing a swipe trail behind them, then lift (shrinking) and slide quickly back, touching down where they started with a small pop. Strong: the fingertips press in first, swipe farther, lift higher and land with a bouncier two-beat touch-down. The pad never moves.
